info.title: Hermes Remote API
info.description: The authenticated web API in front of a Hermes agent. Errors always use the Error schema.

scopes.description: Must be in the key's user-grantable list

input.description: Required for user tokens; system/developer turns in an array are dropped

Forwarded.description: Forwarded to the agent's API server unchanged

dataUrl.description: Inline base64 data URL whose type matches `type`

bearer.description: An hk_ API key, a user JWT, or a token-exchange token
